instruction: Everything in my amazon cart is for my roommate, Troy. Request them money for it on venmo. Ignore tax and delivery fees from the cart cost.
notes: Three apps plus supervisor. Amazon login + show_cart yields the cart item cost (pre-tax, no delivery); phone login + search_contacts (query 'Troy', pick roommate) yields Troy's email; venmo login + create_payment_request(user_email=Troy's email, amount=cart cost) creates exactly one PaymentRequest, matching the evaluation (one added request to the roommate's venmo user for the cart cost). Static facts (username-for, password-for, token-for, email-of, query-for, cart-cost, roommate) only name objects; knowledge predicates (passwords-known, has-token, known-email, known-amount) gate downstream calls. supervisor-complete-task takes the person and amount as task-record parameters (not API arguments) so its precondition can state the goal; no answer is passed since the task is not a question.
